method: Whole HelpersTasks.cpp935lines and HelpersTasks.h manually read; bytes matched pinned Git objects. No task/API execution.
findings: CreateHardlinkFromFile creates GUID-suffixed temporary hardlink to source, MoveFileEx REPLACE_EXISTING over target, and attempts temp deletion on move failure. It does not read/compare content, lock source and target, or validate unchanged identities against scan evidence. Actual replacement/race behavior untested.

ReadFileContent uses synchronous native ReadFile with optional SetFilePointerEx offset, or globally mutex-serialized MTP stream Seek/Read. OpenMtpStream also serializes shell binding under same mutex. This limits parallel MTP content reads despite multiple possible logical callers.

ComputeFileHashes reads1MiB chunks once and updates all initialized algorithms in parallel, preserves full displayed digest lengths unlike reduced duplicate fingerprints. BCryptHashData return value ignored here; finalization failure skips algorithm output. No crypto failure injection.
ComputeFileHashes allows filesystem sharing write/delete and does not revalidate file generation. Cancellation checked after a nonempty read; no explicit cancellation of blocked read in this helper.

SparsifyFile scans zero runs, cluster-aligns selected ranges, then marks sparse and zero-deallocates ranges. Handle allows concurrent write/delete; no reread or source-generation verification before applying previously detected ranges. No file modification or destructive probe executed.

Sparsify scan breaks on ReadFile error/zero read and may continue processing accumulated ranges; normal boolean return does not independently prove complete read of original length. Custom chunk parameters are not validated in helper; defaults1MiB/minZeroRun64KiB.

Compression opens exclusively for read/write; support cached per resolved volume with separate standard/modern maps. WOF not-beneficial error treated as success. This is operation policy, not throughput evidence.

SID-to-name cache guarded by mutex but has no eviction; WMI enumeration uses infinite waits and checks cancellation only between calls. Drive-mapping tasks async per missing drive and waited with UI updates, without per-server deadline in this module.

DeleteFileForce tries normal delete, clears selected attributes and retries, then delete-on-close and path absence check. No atomic immutable-identity guarantee inferred. All destructive/elevation/WMI operations were only read.
limits: No Windows native reads, MTP, hash, hardlink, sparsification, compression, privilege or registry runtime execution.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation remains deferred.
